reason: As written the falsifier does not discriminate. (1) The counted object is undefined: 'max-bucket/(B^2/M)' is not tied to any incidence structure. A set F in F_p with filter floor(Mx/p) has trivially max-bucket ~B/M (random) or B (interval of length < p/M); pair/chord counts require the actual curve chord profile r(x)=#{(P,Q): x(P+Q)=x} (THM_INCBARRIER1/2) or an explicit point-line system, neither is specified. Toy F as bare subsets of F_p never touches the ST point/line configuration. (2) The ST bound B^{3/2-eps} is stated with unspecified eps and constants (arXiv 2609.27023 not in brief/, novelty_unverified); 'excess exponent <= ST bound' is unfalsifiable at p 2^20..2^30 because B^{3/2-eps} vs B^2/M comparison needs B^{1/2+eps} > M-ish, and with M<=1024 and B<=p^0.7 the two terms cross inside the sampled range so fitted exponents are crossover artefacts. Also like MP-additive_comb-2, p spans only 2^10 so no p-exponent fit is meaningful; for random F the max bucket is Poisson-concentrated (excess ~ sqrt(log M)) so exponent is ~0 by construction and the random arm is a null that cannot fail. (3) prediction_if_false is unfalsifiable: any violator (group-AP, interval, subgroup) is dismissed 'restate modulo trivial relations'; interval and AP F with M-bucket intervals are known trivial gain-M cases (whole F in one bucket), so the 'false' outcome is guaranteed and uninformative; no pre-registered criterion separating trivial from nontrivial structure. (4) Compute: pair counting B^2 reaches 2^42 at p=2^30, beta=0.7; infeasible in 12 CPU-min with python/numpy; FFT sumset on F_p needs p-length arrays (2^30 complex, ~16 GB). Feasible only p<=2^24, B<=~2^12-2^13 via exact O(B^2) or sort-merge. (5) Theta: the experiment cannot output theta in [2/5,7/10]; theta is a derived quantity from a proved bilinear estimate (analytic computation from ST statement), not measurable on toys. The toy can only test whether a hypothesised bound holds, not produce theta. (6) Scaling to p~2^130: bound is stated in B=p^beta so formally scale-free, but toy beta-range and constants/eps are not extrapolable, and the programme-relevant F is x-coordinates of a factor base on a specific curve (chord structure), not arbitrary F. Metric (max-bucket count, T_3-like counts) is a counted/structural quantity, not wall time: OK.
